about: Your equipment library: one row per item you use repeatedly (light fittings, A/C units, pumps, heaters...).
Name and Power (W) are required. 'Schedule column' links the item to a column of the DEWA load schedule (e.g. LTG, 'S' A/C).
Phases: 1 or 3. Power factor and demand factor are optional (blank = the app's default).
Save the file and the app updates within a second or two. Projects that use an item pick up its new values automatically.
Cable data used by every calculation: one row per conductor size.
Pre-filled with the app's reference values (Cu/XLPE multicore, free air, 30 °C) - replace them with your manufacturer's datasheet.
R at 20 °C in ohm/km (IEC 60228), reactance X in ohm/km, current rating in A before ambient derating. Rate per m is used for the BOQ.
If this sheet is empty or unreadable the app falls back to its reference values and says so on the Database screen.
Breaker ratings the app may choose from when sizing, and their prices for the BOQ.
One row per rating (A). Icu (kA) is the breaking capacity offered at that rating (optional; blank = the standard Icu steps).
Pre-filled with standard ratings - delete rows you don't stock and add your prices.
Your standard design parameters, applied to every new project (and to an open project with 'Apply parameters').
Leave a value blank to keep the app's built-in default. Only the Value column is read.
